name: Vessel basin mixer and mirror

placement.front_direction: Countertop mounting plane Z=0; wall / mirror toward +Y; front -Y.
placement.allowed_scaling: Rigid placement and Z rotation only. Publish a dimensional sibling instead of nonuniform scaling.

installation.mounting: Vessel bowl sits on countertop plane Z=0. Rear mixer requires countertop fixing; separate mirror/backing requires a structural wall at local +Y. Mirror back is approximately 0.3475 m behind the mounting origin.

operating_envelope.basis: Original concept geometry; no manufacturer selected
operating_envelope.modeled_state: Open vessel bowl; static mixer; wall-mounted mirror
operating_envelope.notes: Verify basin height, faucet reach and handwashing space in host. Mirror is not supported by the basin; no reach or mobility compliance is asserted.

service_requirements: Provide basin waste opening, trap, supply connections and service access below counter. Drain rough-ins are not modeled.
Coordinate mirror attachment, wet-area electrical interfaces and splash-resistant wall finish; no product rating supplied.
